newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAB shares bounce as results beat forecasts.
newsitem.headline: SAB shares bounce as results beat forecasts.

text.p: Shares in South African Breweries Ltd (SAB) bounced firmer following the release of better-than-expected half-year results on Wednesday, after stocks traded weaker for most of the morning.
"The shares are going a bit better. The results were better than we forecast," a dealer said.
Results for the six months ended September 30 showed SAB's attributable earnings rising to 185.2 cents above analysts' expectations of a range of 167 - 182 cents.
Stocks climbed from being 75 cents weaker shortly before the release at 1229 GMT to 75 cents stronger at 116.50 rand, minutes thereafter.
However, shares had since slid off their best levels to trade steady at 115.75 rand.
Dealers said the robust results were expected to provide direction to industrial shares during the afternoon, lifting the index off its lows.
